chunks: Whatsoever dwells in the night and day belongs to Him. He is all-hearing and all-knowing.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that everything that dwells in the night and day belongs to God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the comprehensive sovereignty of Allah over all creation, distinguishing between those who dwell permanently and those who merely rest, thereby affirming His absolute dominion over time and space. The attribution of 'Al-Samī‘' (The All-Hearing) and 'Al‘Alīm' (The All-Knowing) serves as a theological foundation for divine omniscience, reinforcing the concept that no hidden state of any creature escapes His notice, a principle often cited in discussions of divine justice and providence.
